title: yummy molten mexican chilies tamales
description: A twist on traditional tamales, these feature a molten, char-grilled chili filling within a crunchy pretzel-based corn husk.
instructions: Combine 2 cups of masa harina and 1/2 cup of lard in a large bowl and mix until crumbly.
Gradually add 1/2 cup of chicken broth to the masa mixture until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until pliable.
Cut the dough into 12 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Stretch a corn husk to fit over each dough ball and fold the top over the tamale.
Wrap a piece of aluminum foil around each tamale to prevent steam from escaping during cooking.
Char-grill the tamales over medium heat for 5 minutes on each side.
While tamales are cooking, melt 2 tablespoons of lard in a skillet over medium heat.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves to the skillet and sauté for 1 minute.
Add 1 cup of diced, char-grilled chili to the skillet and stir to combine.
Remove the tamales from the foil and place them on a serving plate.
Spoon the chili mixture onto each tamale and top with a sprinkle of crumbled pretzels.
